_schema.description: Canonical directory layout for the Nuclear Scaling project. Every directory is an object. Keys starting with '_' are metadata; every other key is a subdirectory. Anything not listed here does not belong in the tree.

metadata_keys._path: Absolute path of a root (same on every machine)
metadata_keys._machines: Where the directory exists: local, cheaha
metadata_keys._git: tracked (in the repo) | ignored (inside the repo folder but listed in .gitignore) | n/a (outside the repo)
metadata_keys._created_by: scaffold (created once, by hand or script) | the notebook that creates it at run time
metadata_keys._pattern: Naming pattern for directories created at run time
metadata_keys._run_template: Structure of each pipeline-created run folder; not created by the scaffold

conventions.one_current_version: Each active folder holds only the version currently in use. Older versions live under Code_Repository/Deprecated/ at the same relative path.
retiring_a_version: 1. Tag the repo while the old version still works: git tag <tool>-v<version> && git push --tags
2. Move it with git mv (not a plain mv) so its history follows: git mv Python/<folder>/<file> Deprecated/Python/<folder>/<file>
3. Add one line to Deprecated/DEPRECATED.md: file, date, replaced by, reason
4. Commit and push from ONE machine, then pull everywhere else

tag_naming.recover: git checkout <tag> gives a runnable copy of the whole repo as it was at that version

conventions.deprecated_vs_to_delete: Deprecated/ is permanent and tracked: code you built on. _to_delete/ is temporary and gitignored: files awaiting your review before deletion.

code_root._desc: Parent folder for all project code and the git root (github.com/Tdeibert/Nuclear_Scaling_ML). Only this root is under git; the data root never is.

Code_Repository._desc: All source code: R and Python. Moves and renames are made on ONE machine, pushed, and pulled everywhere else.

Environments._desc: Conda environment files (*.yml) for recreating the project environments

Analysis._desc: Analysis notebooks that query the database

Minerva._desc: Minerva plans (*.minerva.yaml) for the Analysis code
Minerva plans (*.minerva.yaml) for the Image_Segmentation code
Minerva plans (*.minerva.yaml) for the Model_Training code

Database._desc: ADDED: importer, DB access layer, and schema definitions (.sql DDL). The code is tracked; the database file itself lives in data_root/Database on the local machine only.

Minerva._desc: Minerva plans (*.minerva.yaml) for the Database code

Utilities._desc: Shared helper modules and utility notebooks

Minerva._desc: Minerva plans (*.minerva.yaml) for the Utilities code

Nuclear_Scaling_Core._desc: Installable package of shared modules (pip install -e . --no-deps in each environment). Replaces src/ and all sys.path imports; see its README.md for the decision record.

nuclear_scaling._desc: The importable package: nsdb, experiment_config, project_paths, paths_config, nsplots, radial_surface

Deprecated._desc: Permanent archive of retired versions. Mirrors the active tree (Python/<folder>/, R/<folder>/) so an old version sits at the same relative path it had when active. Archived files are for reference; use the matching git tag for a runnable copy.

Python._desc: Same subfolders as Python/, created as needed when something is retired

R._desc: Same subfolders as R/, created as needed when something is retired

Models._desc: Models saved during training (checkpoints, training outputs). Must be listed in .gitignore. A model is copied to data_root/Inputs/Models only when it becomes a callable model for segmentation.

_to_delete._desc: Temporary quarantine for files awaiting review before deletion. Must be listed in .gitignore. Emptied periodically; nothing here is expected to survive.

Docs._desc: Presentation materials, manuscripts, plan documents and other project writing. Kept beside the code but never committed.

data_root._desc: Where data is written out and stored. Lives on Cheaha; mirrored locally through the /data/user/tdeibert symlink, so paths are identical everywhere. Never under git.

Inputs._desc: Everything the pipeline and training read from

Models._desc: Callable models used during segmentation. Separate from the training Models folder in the code root.

Condition._desc: One folder per experimental condition. Each holds the raw .tif files (named <experiment_id>, e.g. control_extract_1.1) and their Acquisition sidecar JSONs.

Regions_of_Interest._desc: Fiji RoiSet.zip files for this condition
Fiji RoiSet.zip files for this condition
Fiji RoiSet.zip files for this condition
Fiji RoiSet.zip files for this condition

Runs._desc: Parent folder for segmentation runs. The scaffold creates only this empty folder; each run folder inside it is created by the pipeline.

_run_template._desc: One folder per experiment x config. Created on Cheaha; database_export/ is pulled to local for import.
_run_template._TODO: Fill in the remaining run subfolders from v18.1's RunPaths

database_export._desc: Exporter output: one CSV per table. Input to the local importer.

Database._desc: SQLite database for the whole project. LOCAL ONLY: never on Cheaha, never in git. The importer reads Runs/*/database_export/ and writes here.

Radial_Profiles._desc: zstd parquet files holding bulk radial-profile rows; the database keeps only pointer rows to these

Outputs._desc: Finished products made from the data (not pipeline run output, which lives in Runs/)

Figures._desc: Figure components for papers and presentations

Images._desc: Image panels: montages, representative crops, annotated micrographs

Plots._desc: Data plots: rose plots, growth curves, significance plots (from R or Python)
